_comment: CouchDB document types for the robot inspection MCP server (12 Layer 1 tools). All documents live in the iot DB alongside timestamped IoT sensor readings. None contain an asset_id field, so existing IoT server queries ({asset_id: {$exists: true}}) are unaffected.

asset_robot_profile.description: Per-asset physical layout and panel state. Seeded by seed_robot_profiles.py. Scenario-specific state (e.g. panel_stuck=true for R001) is loaded by the eval harness via the shared robot JSON files.

physical_location.purpose: Facility floor-plan coordinates used by navigate_to() as the GraphNav navigation target. Null until floor-plan data is collected for the asset.

gauge_path.purpose: File path or URL of the physical gauge image captured by capture_image(). Null until field data has been collected. When non-null and panel_stuck=false, the VLM perception agent can read the gauge value from this image.

gauge_range.purpose: Physical measurement range of the gauge (e.g. [0, 400] for a 0–400 bar pressure gauge). Included in the vlm_hint string returned by capture_image() so the VLM agent knows the scale.

gauge_description.purpose: Plain English description of the gauge and its units (e.g. 'Compressor outlet pressure gauge, analog dial, 0–400 bar'). Included in the vlm_hint string returned by capture_image().

panel_stuck.purpose: True when the physical inspection panel cannot be opened by the robot arm. open_panel() returns access_granted=false and capture_image() returns occlusion_flag=true when panel_stuck=true. Represents a physical kinematic failure (panel seized, corroded, or obstructed) that requires human maintenance escalation.

robot_state.description: Per-robot battery, pose, power and stance state. Robot-level, not asset-level. Seeded by seed_robot_profiles.py. power_state and stance_state added to support the 6 motion tools (power_on, power_off, stand, sit, dock, undock).

battery_charge_pct.purpose: Current battery charge percentage. get_battery() reads this. When battery_charge_pct < battery_low_threshold, get_battery() returns low_battery=true and the agent must abort the inspection and return to the charging dock immediately.

battery_low_threshold.purpose: Threshold percentage below which the mission must be aborted. get_battery() computes low_battery = (battery_charge_pct < battery_low_threshold).

battery_estimated_runtime_s.purpose: Estimated remaining runtime in seconds. Informational — included in the get_battery() message to help the agent judge whether the battery will last the inspection.

at_charge_station.purpose: True if the robot is currently docked at a charging station. Included in the get_battery() response for context.

pose.purpose: Current robot pose in the facility map frame. get_pose() reads this. The agent should call get_pose() after navigate_to() to confirm the robot arrived at the intended location.

localization_ok.purpose: False when the robot cannot localise itself in the facility map (e.g. map data stale, fiducial missing, encoder drift too large). When false, get_pose() returns localization_ok=false and the agent must abort the inspection and raise a work order for robot remapping — taking a gauge reading from an unverified position risks reading the wrong asset.

pose_drift_m.purpose: Estimated pose error in metres. get_pose() issues a warning when drift > 0.5 m. When localization_ok=false this field typically exceeds 0.5 m (e.g. 1.8 m in the localisation failure scenario).

fault_state.purpose: Active robot fault, if any. Null means nominal. get_pose() surfaces this in the response. A non-null fault_state requires human intervention before the mission can continue.

power_state.purpose: Motor power state. power_on() and power_off() read this field. Maps to bosdyn.client.power.PowerClient.power_on_motors() / power_off_motors() in the real Spot SDK. The robot must be POWERED_ON before stand(), sit(), navigate_to(), or open_panel() can succeed.

stance_state.purpose: Robot stance. stand() and sit() read this field. Maps to bosdyn.client.robot_command.RobotCommandBuilder.synchro_stand_command() / synchro_sit_command(). The robot must be SITTING before power_off() is allowed. Call sit() before dock() at mission end.

waypoints.description: Singleton document mapping assets to Spot GraphNav waypoint IDs. list_waypoints() returns the waypoints array. The agent must call list_waypoints() before navigate_to() to confirm the target waypoint exists and is active.

item_schema.waypoint_id: string — Spot GraphNav waypoint UUID or short name
item_schema.waypoint_name: string — human-readable name shown in the Spot app
item_schema.asset_id: string or null — normalized asset ID this waypoint serves (null for the dock)
item_schema.location_description: string — plain English location for logging
item_schema.active: bool — false if the waypoint has been deleted or the plant reconfigured since last mapping. When false, navigate_to() for that asset must not be called — the agent must escalate and raise a work order for waypoint remapping.

waypoints.purpose: Authoritative list of inspection waypoints loaded from the Spot GraphNav map. list_waypoints() filters by asset_id when provided. A missing or inactive waypoint for the target asset represents a plant reconfiguration event that requires human re-mapping of the facility.

isolation_guarantee: No robot document contains an asset_id field. IoT server queries {asset_id: {$exists: true}} cannot match any robot document.

indexes.name: idx_robot_state_by_robot
indexes.purpose: get_battery() and get_pose() lookup by robot_id

indexes.name: idx_waypoints_singleton
indexes.purpose: list_waypoints() fetch of the singleton waypoints document
